'''Alejo Vidal-Quadras Roca''' (born 20 May 1945) is a Spanish former politician and [[radiation]] physicist. Born in [[Barcelona]], he served as a [[Member of the European Parliament]] (MEP) from 1999 to 2014 and as [[Vice-Presidents of the European Parliament|First Vice-President of the European Parliament]] from 2004 to 2007. He survived an assassination attempt in 2023, he says was ordered by [[Iran]], which became known in Spain as "[[The Sunflower case]]".

== Career ==
Vidal-Quadras was elected on the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]] ticket and sat with the [[European People's Party]] group. In 2014, he announced that he was leaving the People's Party for a new party, [[Vox (Spanish political party)|Vox]]. He was the frontrunner for Vox in the [[2014 European Parliament election in Spain|2014 European election]], but the party failed to win a seat. He is a member of the European Friends of Israel, a lobby group aiming to defend Israel's interests within the European Union.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://diario16.com/politicos-espanoles-se-unen-al-movimiento-mas-poderoso-amigos-europeos-israel/|title=Políticos españoles se unen al movimiento más poderoso de Amigos Europeos por Israel|date=3 December 2017}}</ref>

==Relationship with Iran==
In 2013 ''[[El País]]'' reported that 35 Iranian dissidents said to be affiliated to the [[National Council of Resistance of Iran]] (NCRI) gave Vox about one million euros. According to Vidal-Quadras, the donations were not made to Vox but to himself.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://elpais.com/espana/2023-11-11/la-carpeta-secreta-de-vidal-quadras-con-los-donantes-iranies-de-vox.html|title=La carpeta secreta de Vidal-Quadras con los donantes iraníes de Vox|work=El País|language=es|date=11 November 2023|first1=José María|last1=Irujo|first2=Joaquín|last2=Gil}}</ref>

After 2014, Vidal-Quadras operated {{lang|la|pro bono}} the International Committee in Search of Justice (ISJ), a Brussels-based lobby supporting the NCRI against the Iranian government.<ref name="Suanzes">{{cite news |last1=Suanzes |first1=Pablo R. |title=Alejo Vidal-Quadras, fundador de Vox: "Abascal sabía que el dinero era iraní y le parecía muy bien" |url=https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2019/01/23/5c4776f621efa0d67c8b4664.html |access-date=2 May 2021 |work=ELMUNDO |date=23 January 2019 |language=es-ES}}</ref><ref name="ISJ">{{cite web |title=The Committee |url=http://isjcommittee.com/the-committee/ |website=International Committee In Search of Justice |date=27 May 2020 |access-date=2 May 2021 |quote=PRESIDENT Alejo Vidal Quadras}}</ref>

Vidal-Quadras has aligned with [[People's Mojahedin of Iran]], which led the Iranian Foreign Ministry to impose sanctions on him in 2023. The Iran Foreign Ministry accused Vidal-Quadras of "supporting terrorism and terrorist groups" while [[Maryam Rajavi]] said that "Prof. Vidal-Quadras has dedicated an important part of his life to fight against [Iran's ruling religious fascism]".<ref name=ap/>

=== Attempted assassination ===
On 9 November 2023, Vidal-Quadras was shot in the face in [[Madrid]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Fahey |first=Ryan|date=2023-11-09 |title=Politician shot in the face in busy city centre by brazen gunman on motorbike |url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-alejo-vidal-quadras-spanish-31401002 |access-date=2023-11-09 |website=The Mirror |language=en}}</ref> by a person on a motorbike in {{ill|Calle de Núñez de Balboa|es}} at 1:30&nbsp;p.m. local time.<ref name=ap>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-09 |title=Spanish conservative politician shot in face in Madrid. Gunman escaped on a motorbike, reports say |url=https://apnews.com/article/spain-shooting-politician-d98bb2f3c482eb006ece10b8669d4c12 |access-date=2023-11-09 |website=AP News |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-09 |title=Herido grave en Madrid Alejo Vidal-Quadras, ex presidente del PP de Cataluña y fundador de VOX, tras recibir un disparo en la cara |url=https://www.elmundo.es/madrid/2023/11/09/654cdd3ee9cf4a02628b45af.html |access-date=2023-11-09 |website=ELMUNDO |language=es}}</ref> He was taken to hospital and was described as recovering after suffering a fracture on his jawbone that required surgery.<ref name=ap/> The assassination attempt is being investigated as a possible terrorist attack.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-14 |title=Attempted murder of right wing Spanish politician being investigated as "terrorist" incident|url=https://www.politico.eu/article/spain-alejo-vidal-quadras-attempted-murder-terrorist-incident-court/ |access-date=2023-11-14 |website=Politico|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-14 |title=La Audiencia Nacional investiga el disparo a Vidal-Quadras como un delito de terrorismo|url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20231113/9373318/audiencia-nacional-asume-investigacion-presunto-ataque-terrorista-vidal-quadras.html|access-date=2023-11-14 |website=La Vanguardia|language=es}}</ref> On November 21, Spanish police arrested three people in connection to the shooting.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/21/arrested-shooting-former-rightwing-politician-madrid-alejo-vidal-quadras |title=Three arrested over shooting of former rightwing politician in Madrid|website=The Guardian|language=en}}</ref>

Vidal-Quadras has claimed that Iran was behind the attempted assassination.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-10 |title=La Policía investiga si Irán está tras el intento de asesinato a Vidal-Quadras |url=https://www.elmundo.es/madrid/2023/11/09/654cdd3ee9cf4a02628b45af.html |access-date=2023-11-10 |website=ELMUNDO |language=es}}</ref> According to Vidal-Quadras, his connection to the [[National Council of Resistance of Iran]], an [[Iranian opposition]] group, could be linked to the assassination attempt.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-13 |title=Vidal-Quadras y otros dos políticos españoles están en la "lista de terroristas" del régimen de Irán por apoyar el CNRI |url=https://www.eleconomista.es/actualidad/noticias/12532157/11/23/vidalquadras-y-otros-dos-politicos-espanoles-estan-en-la-lista-de-terroristas-del-regimen-de-iran-por-apoyar-el-cnri.html |access-date=2023-11-13 |website=ELECONOMISTA |language=es}}</ref> To date, eight people have been arrested, including Mehrez Ayari who is linked to the [[Mocro Maffia]].<ref>{{Cite web|title= Vidal-Quadras accuses Iran of the attack before a judge: all the key points of the case|url=https://en.ara.cat/politics/vidal-quadras-accuses-iran-of-the-attack-before-judge-all-the-key-points-of-the-case_1_5348844.html |website=ARA|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=How Iran is using European mafia to kill its political opponents|url=https://www.thetimes.com/world/middle-east/article/alejo-vidal-quadras-assassination-plot-iran-dutch-mafia-p26xczm3z|website=The Times|language=en}}</ref> Sami Bekal Bounouare, a Palma-born man believed to be the mastermind behind the attack, remains at large.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://en.ara.cat/politics/vidal-quadras-accuses-iran-of-the-attack-before-judge-all-the-key-points-of-the-case_1_5348844.html |title=Vidal-Quadras accuses Iran of the attack before a judge: all the key points of the case|website=ARA|language=en}}</ref>

Vidal-Quadras is one of the first politicians that Tehran has added to their terrorist list.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-10 |title=Intento de asesinato a Vidal-Quadras: la sospecha iraní, un pistolero "profesional" y un giro de cuello que le pudo salvar la vida|url=https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2023/11/10/654d531ae4d4d8e77f8b4573.html |access-date=2023-11-10 |website=ELMUNDO |language=es}}</ref> The Iranian opposition attributes the authorship to religious fascist elements that govern the country.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2023-11-22 |title=Conference at the European Parliament, Strasbourg |url=https://www.maryam-rajavi.com/en/conference-strasbourg-parliament-standing-against-main-instigator-war-iranian-regime/ |access-date=2024-01-05 |website=Maryam Rajavi |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-09 |title=Spanish far-right politician shot in the face suspects a link to his work with Iranian opposition |url=https://apnews.com/article/spain-shooting-politician-d98bb2f3c482eb006ece10b8669d4c12 |access-date=2024-01-05 |website=AP News |language=en}}</ref> In 2019 Vidal-Quadras stated that he considers the Iranian regime a cruel dictatorship which foments terrorism.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-10 |title=Po que Vidal-Quadras responsibiliza a Iran del disparo sufrido en Madrid?|url=https://www.20minutos.es/noticia/5189169/0/atentado-contra-alejo-vidal-quadras-las-razones-que-iran-tendria-para-intentar-acabar-con-su-vida/ |access-date=2023-11-10 |website=20MINUTOS |language=es}}</ref> He is the first European politician to be targeted within Europe.<ref>{{Cite news |last=David Maddox |title=Top EU politician who survived Iran assassination plot delivers 'end appeasement' plea to Cameron|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/cameron-iran-assassination-revolutinary-guard-proscribe-b2540898.html|work=Independent}}</ref>

=== Aftermath ===
In January 2024, a suspect in the assassination attempt was arrested in Colombia. Currently four individuals have been arrested in connection with the shooting, while the alleged shooter, a French citizen of Tunisian descent with multiple prior convictions in France, is still at large.

Also Vidal-Quadras called for a change in the EU policy towards the Islamic Republic to avoid trying to "appease, to negotiate, to dialogue and to make concessions".<ref>Spanish politician shot in Madrid points finger at Iran | Reuters</ref>

== Political positions ==
Alejo Vidal-Quadras defines himself as liberal-conservative. He is the founder of far-right political party [[Vox (political party)|Vox]], and is opposed to abortion rights and gay marriage.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.larazon.es/noticia/vidal-quadras-acusa-a-los-socialistas-de-destruir-con-su-politica-del-aborto |title=Vidal-Quadras acusa a los socialistas de destruir con su política del aborto |website=www.larazon.es |access-date=12 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111104134424/http://www.larazon.es/noticia/vidal-quadras-acusa-a-los-socialistas-de-destruir-con-su-politica-del-aborto |archive-date=4 November 2011 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2014-03-06 |title=Vidal-Quadras responde a Enraizados sobre la postura de Vox acerca del matrimonio, el derecho a la vida y la educación |url=https://infocatolica.com/?t=noticia&cod=20164 |access-date=2025-03-03 |work=InfoCatólica |language=es}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
He currently lives off his pensions as a former university professor and a former member of the European Parliament.<ref name="Suanzes"/> In addition to serving in the European Parliament, he has occupied several elected positions in Spain: he was a member of the Barcelona City Council (1987–1991), member of the [[Parliament of Catalonia]] (1988–1996) and Senator in the [[Spanish Senate]] (1996–1999).

==Books about politics==

* "Cuestión de fondo" (Editorial Montesinos, 1993);
* "Amarás a tu tribu" (Editorial Planeta, 1998);
* "Ahora, cambio de rumbo" (Editorial Planeta, 2012).
